blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. Experiments on standard LLM unlearning benchmarks (TOFU and RWKU) show that COP preserves utility across sequential requests without weakening forgetting, preventing the collapse of standard objectives and forgetting more effectively than continual-specific baselines.
blocks.zh: 失学涉及从模型中去除培训数据敏感部分的影响,例如受保护、版权或私人文本,而不从零开始对其进行再培训。 虽然在模型存在期间不断出现不学习请求,但绝大多数LLM不学习方法不适合累赘去除,导致在相继去学时遗忘和有用性急剧衰减。 这种衰变源于相继更新之间的干扰,因为每次新删除都会使更早的版本被取消,或者将模型进一步推向它们已经退化的方向. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了连续正弦投影(COP),这是一个梯度-投影方案,它将每次更新限制在从先前的遗忘集中缓存的激活子空间的正弦补充. 这种做法可以证明是先行先行,先行后行,先行后行。 COP只存储每层的低等基数,既不需要过去的梯度,也不需要以前的被遗忘的套数,并插入不学习的方法,通过梯度步骤将模型更新到不同的损失上而无需修改其目标. 关于标准LLM的不学习基准(TOFU和RWKU)的实验表明,缔约方会议在不削弱遗忘、防止标准目标倒闭和比持续的特定基线更有效地忘记的前提下,保持了连续请求的效用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are trained on web-scale corpora that inevitably include private, copyrighted, or harmful content, which they can memorize and reproduce ( Carlini et al., 2021 ; Carlini et al., 2023 ) .
Model providers therefore increasingly face requests to remove specific data from trained models ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . Because retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive at this scale, machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of selected training data directly from a trained model ( Cao and Yang, 2015 ; Bourtoule et al., 2021 ; Guo et al., 2020 ) , erasing targeted information while preserving general capabilities. Long-lived deployments receive these requests sequentially over time, a setting referred to as continual unlearning, in which each new deletion must preserve the effect of earlier ones without access to the data they targeted, while also preventing utility losses from accumulating across successive requests.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)在网络尺度的corpora上接受培训,不可避免地包括私人,版权,或有害的内容,他们可以记住和复制这些内容(Carlini等人,2021;Carlini等人,2023).
因此,模型提供者越来越多地面临从经过培训的模型中删除具体数据的要求(Shi等人,2025年)。 由于从零开始的再培训在这个规模上是极其昂贵的,因此机器不学习试图从训练有素的模型中直接去除某些培训数据的影响(曹和杨,2015年;Bourtoule等人,2021年;Guo等人,2020年),在保留一般能力的同时去除目标信息. 长寿的部署按时间顺序接收这些请求,这种环境被称为持续不学习,在这种背景下,每次新的删除都必须保持先前请求的效力,而不能获取它们所针对的数据,同时防止公用事业损失在接连提出的请求中积累。

blocks.en: Most LLM unlearning methods optimize a gradient-based forget objective, such as gradient ascent (GA) ( Jang et al., 2023 ) , negative preference optimization (NPO) ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , or its reference-free variant SimNPO ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , alongside a retain regularizer that balances deletion against utility preservation. These methods are designed for isolated requests, and applying them in sequence lets successive updates interfere with one another. Each step can undo earlier deletions or further degrade what they removed, and the retain set alone cannot stop the resulting utility erosion as the request stream grows ( Gao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 大多数LLM未学习方法优化了基于梯度的忘却目标,如梯度升降(GA)(Jang等人,2023年),负偏好优化(NPO)(Zhang等人,2024年),或其无参考变量. SimNPO(Fan等人,2025年),同时保留一种规范化剂,在删除和公用事业保存之间保持平衡。 这些方法是为孤立请求而设计的,按顺序应用这些方法使得连续更新互相干扰. 每一步都能够取消先前删除的内容或进一步降解它们删除的内容,而仅保留部分无法随着请求流的增加而阻止由此造成的公用事业侵蚀(Gao等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Methods designed for the continual setting either move unlearning out of the base model or separate the parameters that each request modifies. O 3 ( Gao et al., 2025 ) follows the first strategy, freezing the base model and learning all deletions in a shared LoRA adapter, applied at inference according to an out-of-distribution detector. Its behavior is thus contingent on detection errors, and the targeted information remains recoverable from the base weights. ALKN ( Wuerkaixi et al., 2025 ) follows the second, updating the weights through task vectors, encouraging each request to modify a distinct subset of parameters and reducing unlearning intensity where earlier requests already acted. However, separating the parameters each request modifies does not separate their effects. Since every input is processed by the whole network, a new deletion can still interfere with earlier ones by changing the model’s behavior on previously forgotten data. In our experiments, neither O 3 nor ALKN maintains both forgetting and utility as requests accumulate.
blocks.zh: 为持续设置而设计的方法要么不学习基础模型,要么将每个请求修改的参数分开。 O 3(Gao et al.,2025)遵循了第一个策略,冻结了基模型,并在一个共享的LORA适配器中学习所有删除,根据分流探测器推论应用. 因此,其行为取决于检测错误,目标信息仍可从基重中恢复。 ALKN(Wuerkaixi等人,2025年)紧随第二条,通过任务矢量更新权重,鼓励每项请求修改不同的子集参数,并在先前的请求已经采取行动的情况下降低未学习强度。 然而,将每个请求修改的参数分开并不区分其效果. 由于每个输入都由整个网络处理,新的删除仍然可以通过改变模型在先前被遗忘的数据上的行为来干扰早期的输入. 在我们的实验中 O 3 和 ALKN 都没有在请求累积时同时保持遗忘和效用.

blocks.en: We address this interference by formalizing continual unlearning as a constrained sequential empirical risk minimization problem in which each update must not substantially alter previously satisfied unlearning objectives. Rather than enforcing these constraints through stored parameter gradients, we exploit a layer-wise factorization of the gradient that allows them to be enforced through orthogonality conditions in the much lower-dimensional input activation space, avoiding the need to store past gradients. This results in Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP) , a lightweight plug-in that projects each gradient update onto the orthogonal complement of low-rank subspaces spanned by cached activations from prior forget sets.
blocks.zh: 我们处理这种干扰的方式是,将持续不学习正规化,将其作为一个有限的连续经验风险最小化问题,其中每次更新都不得大大改变以前满足的不学习目标。 与其通过存储的参数梯度强制执行这些制约,不如利用梯度的分层因子化,允许在更低维的输入激活空间通过正交条件强制执行这些制约,避免存储过去梯度的需要. 这导致了连续正交投影(COP),一种轻量级插件,将每个梯度更新投影到从先前的遗忘组合中缓存激活的低阶子空间的正交补充上.

blocks.en: Once a request has been processed, we treat its level of forgetting as settled, so later updates have no reason to move along its directions. Further forget steps in these directions would erase more than was accepted at an additional cost in utility, while retain steps could reinstate the forgotten content. COP therefore projects the full update, retain gradient included, so the retain loss repairs utility only in directions orthogonal to earlier deletions. Because it acts only on the gradient, COP works with any unlearning method that updates the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss, requiring no changes to its objective and no classifier at inference time. On TOFU and RWKU, COP preserves more utility than the base objectives without weakening forgetting, and outperforms continual unlearning baselines.
blocks.zh: 一旦一项请求得到处理,我们就将其遗忘的程度视为已经解决,因此以后的更新没有理由沿着其方向前进。 进一步忘记这些方向上的步骤将消除被接受的更多,增加效用成本,同时保留这些步骤可以恢复被遗忘的内容。 因此,缔约方会议预测,包括了全面更新,保留梯度,因此,保留的损失修复功能只在正向方向进行,直至删除。 由于它只作用于梯度,缔约方会议采用任何不学习的方法,通过梯度步骤对模型进行不同损失的更新,不需要改变其目标,也不需要在推论时间进行分类。 在TOFU和RWKU方面,缔约方会议保持了比基准目标更多的效用,同时又没有削弱遗忘,而且业绩超过了持续不学习的基线。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: 1. a formalization of continual unlearning as a constrained sequential empirical risk minimization (ERM) problem, deriving a first-order interference condition that motivates Continual Orthogonal Projection for any differentiable unlearning objective; 2. a gradient projection scheme which protects prior deletions by projecting updates away from cached activation subspaces, with first-order non-interference guarantees, no additional asymptotic cost, and memory that scales linearly with each layer’s input dimension; 3. an empirical evaluation showing that COP-augmented methods retain more utility than their base objectives and improve the forget-utility trade-off over continual baselines.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献是: 1. 将持续不学习正式化为限制连续经验风险最小化(ERM)问题,产生一阶干扰条件,促使对任何不同的不学习目标进行连续正弦投影;2. 梯度预测方案,通过将更新从缓存激活子空间中预测出来来保护先前的删除,同时提供第一阶不干预保障,不增加不对称成本,以及根据每一层输入维度线性衡量的内存;3. 实证评价显示,缔约方会议强化的方法比其基准目标更有用,并改进与持续基线的忘却作用权衡。

blocks.en: Continual learning methods exploit this structure to protect earlier tasks. OGD ( Farajtabar et al., 2020 ) projects each new gradient orthogonally to stored gradients of earlier tasks, whereas GPM ( Saha et al., 2021 ) stores a low-rank basis of each layer’s input activations and projects updates orthogonally to it. COP adopts GPM’s activation-space projection but builds the subspaces from past forget sets, so the quantity it protects is the value each earlier unlearning objective reached. Prior unlearning methods use projection either within a single request to protect retained data, as GU ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) does for LLMs, or across requests in vision models, as in FG-OrIU ( Feng et al., 2025 ) ; COP targets continual LLM unlearning and leaves the unlearning objective unchanged. Appendix A discusses related work in more detail.

blocks.en: We cast continual unlearning as a constrained sequential empirical risk minimization problem, seeking parameters that achieve forgetting on ℱ k \mathcal{F}_{k} , preserve utility on retain data, and avoid interfering with earlier requests, without access to previous forget sets. This problem is formalized and approximated to first order in Section 3.1 , and the resulting constraint is shown to be cheaply enforceable through cached activation subspaces in Section 3.2 . blocks.en: 3.1 Continual unlearning as a constrained ERM problem
blocks.zh: 3.1 持续不学习是一个受限制的机构风险管理问题

blocks.en: Each request is optimized on ℱ k \mathcal{F}_{k} and ℛ \mathcal{R} alone, yet it modifies the same parameters that encode earlier deletions, so earlier forget losses can drift, either restoring removed information or eroding utility. We make this interference explicit by constraining each request to keep earlier forget objectives near their previous values, and derive from the first-order form of these constraints the condition that Section 3.2 enforces from cached activations.

blocks.en: 3.3 Complexity and capacity
blocks.zh: 3.3 复杂性和能力

blocks.en: Protecting earlier requests has two costs: the memory to store the protected subspaces, and the update directions removed from later requests. Both are governed by the rank r r of the basis V k V_{k} at each layer.
blocks.zh: 保护早先的请求有两个成本:存储受保护子空间的内存,以及从后来的请求中删除的更新方向. 两者都受每层Vk V_{k}基础的r r 级管理。

blocks.en: For each linear layer, COP stores only the basis V k V_{k} , which has r ​ d in r\,d_{\mathrm{in}} entries. Neither previous forget sets nor their activations are kept, so memory grows with the rank of the protected subspace rather than with the number or size of the requests. Storing even a single parameter-space gradient would instead require d in ​ d out d_{\mathrm{in}}\,d_{\mathrm{out}} entries per layer. The projection is computed as G k − ( G k ​ V k − 1 ) ​ V k − 1 ⊤ G_{k}-(G_{k}V_{k-1})V_{k-1}^{\top} , without forming P k − 1 P_{k-1} , and adds two light matrix products to each update, which is small compared with a forward and backward pass whenever r r is below the number of tokens in a batch. Building the basis requires one additional forward pass over ℱ k \mathcal{F}_{k} per request, followed by an SVD and a QR decomposition.
blocks.zh: 对于每个线性层,COP只存储基础 V k V_{k},该基础在 r\,d_{\ mathrm{in}}}条目中有 r d. 之前的忘却设定及其激活都没有被保留,所以内存会随着受保护的子空间的级别而不是请求的数量或大小而增长. 存储甚至单个参数- 空间梯度需要 d 在 d 输出 d mathrm{in} , d_{\ mathrm{out} 每层条目 。 预测值为Gk−(Gk V k− 1) Vk− 1QQQQK}-(G_{k}V_{k−1})V_{k−1}^{\top},不形成Pk−1P_{k−1}k−1}k−1}),每次更新时增加两个轻质矩阵产品,只要r低于批次的令牌数量,则与前向和后向的通过相比是小的. 建设基础需要每个请求在 Fk \ mathcal{F}_{k} 上增加一个前传, 之后是 SVD 和 QR 分解 。

blocks.en: The protected subspace also limits what later requests can change. An update satisfying Δ ​ W ​ V k − 1 = 0 \Delta WV_{k-1}=0 acts only on the d in − r d_{\mathrm{in}}-r input directions outside 𝒮 k − 1 \mathcal{S}_{k-1} , and since the bases are nested, r r never decreases from one request to the next. Therefore, each request leaves less room for those that follow, and once 𝒮 k − 1 \mathcal{S}_{k-1} spans the whole input space of a layer, that layer can no longer be updated. Free directions are also not sufficient on their own: if the activations of the current forget set already lie in 𝒮 k − 1 \mathcal{S}_{k-1} , the projected gradient vanishes at that layer even when r < d in r<d_{\mathrm{in}} .
blocks.zh: 受保护的子空间也限制了后来的请求可以改变的内容. 满足 QQ W V k − 1 = 0 = Delta WV_{k-1}=0 的更新只在 S k − 1\ mathcal{ S}_{k-1} 外的 d r mathrm{in}}r 输入方向上进行,而且由于基座是嵌入的,r r r 从未从一个请求减少到下一个请求. 因此,每次请求都给后面的人留下较少的空间,一旦S k − 1\ mathcal{S}_{k-1}跨越一层的整个输入空间,该层就不能再更新了. 自由方向本身也是不够的:如果当前忘却集的激活已经存在于S k − 1\ mathcal{S}_{k-1}中,那么,即便在r < d > mathrm{in} 中,预计的梯度也会在该层消失。

blocks.en: The threshold τ \tau and cap r max r_{\max} keep this growth in check. Each request adds at most r max r_{\max} directions per layer, so after k k requests r ≤ min ⁡ ( d in , k ​ r max ) r\leq\min(d_{\mathrm{in}},\,k\,r_{\max}) , and a lower τ \tau adds fewer directions still. Both leave more of the input space free for later requests, at the price of exact protection: directions discarded by the compression are no longer shielded, and earlier requests may drift along them. Basis compression is thus a way to control capacity and save memory.
blocks.zh: 阈值\ tau 和 max 上限 r 最大 r max ) 保持此增长 。 每个请求最多增加r max r_{\max} 每层方向, 所以在 k k k 请求 r min ( d in , k r max ) r\leq\ min( d_{\ mathrm{in}},\, k\, r_{\max}) 之后, 更低的\ tau 还会增加更少的方向 。 两者都为以后的请求留下了更多的输入空间,以精确保护的价格:压缩所丢弃的方向不再被屏蔽,更早的请求可能沿着它们漂移. 因此基础压缩是控制能力和保存内存的一种方式.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate COP on two benchmarks that probe complementary aspects of unlearning in LLMs. TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) asks the model to forget fictitious authors whose knowledge was introduced only through fine-tuning, isolating the effect of unlearning on entity-specific facts. RWKU ( Jin et al., 2024 ) instead asks it to forget real people whose knowledge was acquired during pretraining, where no controlled fine-tuning stage exists. In both, the forget data is split into T T requests ℱ 1 , … , ℱ T \mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{F}_{T} that every method processes in the same order on a single model, alongside a fixed retain set ℛ \mathcal{R} , and a successful method must forget each request while preserving general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个基准来评估缔约方会议,这些基准将探讨法学硕士课程中未学习的互补方面。 TOFU(Maini等人,2024年)要求模型忘记虚构的作者,他们的知识只是通过微调引入的,孤立了不学习对实体特定事实的影响. RWKU(Jin等人,2024年)则要求它忘记那些在预训期间获得知识的真人,那里没有可控的微调阶段. 在两者中,忘却数据被拆分为T T 请求 F 1, ..., F T\ mathcal{F}_{1},\ ldots,\mathcal{F}_{T} 每种方法在单个模型上以相同的顺序进行处理, 与固定保留集 R\mathcal{R} 一起进行, 一个成功的方法必须在保留一般能力的同时忘记每个请求.

blocks.en: We measure forgetting with forget ROUGE (FR ↓ \downarrow ), forget probability (FP ↓ \downarrow ), exact memorization (EM ↓ \downarrow ) ( Tirumala et al., 2022 ) , and extraction strength (ES ↓ \downarrow ) ( Carlini et al., 2021 ) , reporting FR, ES, and EM on TOFU and FR, FP, and EM on RWKU. After request k k , they are computed over all requests seen so far, so they also capture whether earlier deletions remain forgotten. Utility is measured by model utility (MU ↑ \uparrow ), a harmonic mean of benchmark-specific utility measures. Definitions are given in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们用忘记ROUGE(FR ↓\downarrow),忘记概率(FP ↓\downarrow),精确的记忆(EM ↓\downarrow)(Tirumala等人,2022年),以及提取强度(ES ↓\downarrow)(Carlini等人,2021年),报告FR,ES,以及EM在TOFU和FRWKU上. 在请求k k 之后,它们被计算在迄今所看到的所有请求中,因此它们还记录了先前的删除是否仍然被遗忘。 效用用模型效用(MU QQ \uparrow)来衡量,这是具体基准效用措施的谐音平均值. 定义载于附录B。

blocks.en: We apply COP to four widely used unlearning objectives. Gradient ascent (GA) ( Jang et al., 2023 ) maximizes the likelihood loss on the forget set, NPO ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) recasts forgetting as preference optimization against a fixed reference model, and SimNPO ( Fan et al., 2025 ) removes the reference model in favor of length-normalized rewards. IDK ( Maini et al., 2024 ) replaces the suppression of original answers with fine-tuning toward refusals. Each objective is paired with its COP-augmented counterpart with r max = 256 r_{\max}=256 . We further compare against ALKN ( Wuerkaixi et al., 2025 ) and O 3 ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , methods built for continual unlearning. Each method and variant is tuned for the best forget-utility trade-off (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们把缔约方会议应用于4个广泛使用的不学习目标。 渐渐升起(GA)(Jang等人,2023年)使遗忘集的概率损失最大化,NPO(Zhang等人,2024年)将遗忘作为优选优化与固定参考模型相比,SimNPO(Fan等人,2025年)取消了参考模型,倾向于长度正常化奖励. IDK(Maini等人,2024年)用对拒绝的微调取代了压制原始答复。 每个目标与缔约方会议认可的对应目标配对,最大值=256 r_{\max}=256。 我们还将ALKN(Wuerkaixi等人,2025年)和O 3(Gao等人,2025年)作比较,后者是为继续不学习而制定的方法。 每种方法和变体都为最佳的忘却作用权衡(附录C)调制.

blocks.en: Figure 2: COP preserves utility as forget requests accumulate. Model utility on TOFU ( forget05 ) with Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct after each of the five forget requests, for each base objective (dashed, hollow markers) and its COP-augmented variant (solid, filled markers). The dotted line marks the utility of the original model before unlearning. Utility under COP stays close to its early level as requests accumulate, whereas base GA and IDK collapse and base NPO and SimNPO fall increasingly behind their COP variants in later requests.
blocks.zh: 图2:缔约方会议保留了在遗忘请求累积时的效用。 在TOFU(忘却05)上的模型效用,在五个忘却请求之后,每个都使用Llama-3.2-1B-指示,针对每个基目标(凹陷,空心标记)及其COP加固的变体(固态,填充标记). 点线在未学习之前就标志着原始模型的实用性. 随着请求的累积,缔约方会议下的效用仍然接近其早期水平,而GA和IDK基数崩溃,NPO和SimNPO基数在后来的请求中越来越落后于缔约方会议的变式。

blocks.en: 4.1 TOFU
blocks.zh: 4.1 托芬语

blocks.en: TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) contains question-answer pairs about 200 fictitious authors. We start from the Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct checkpoints fine-tuned on the full dataset by Dorna et al. (2025) and split the forget05 subset into T = 5 T=5 requests of two authors and 40 question-answer pairs each, using retain95 as ℛ \mathcal{R} . MU is the harmonic mean of answer probability, ROUGE, and truth ratio on the retain set, real authors, and world facts ( Maini et al., 2024 ) . Further details are in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: TOFU(Maini等人,2024年)包含约200个虚构作者的问答对. 我们从Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct检查站开始,根据Dorna et al.(2025年)的完整数据集进行微调,将忘却05子集分成T=5T=5个请求,各2个作者和40个问答对,使用保留95作为R\mathcal{R}. MU是解答概率的谐音平均值,ROUGE,以及保留集的真相比,真实作者,以及世界事实(Maini等人,2024年). 详情见附录C.1。

blocks.en: Table 1: TOFU results on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct ( forget05 ). After each task, forget metrics are computed over all requests seen so far, and model utility (MU) is measured on the retain set and general utility datasets. Bold marks the higher MU within each pair of a base objective and its COP-augmented variant. From the third request onward, every COP variant retains higher utility than its base objective. COP prevents the utility collapse of GA and IDK, whose base versions reach lower EM only as part of that collapse, while forget metrics for NPO and SimNPO remain comparable with and without COP. O 3 attains the highest utility but forgets weakly, with EM close to that of the original model. ALKN’s forget metrics fall together with its utility, which collapses as requests accumulate.

blocks.en: Table 2: TOFU results on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct ( forget05 ), with the same metrics and notation as Table 1 . COP improves utility at every request for SimNPO and IDK, from the second request onward for GA, and from the third onward for NPO. Base GA and IDK drive forget ROUGE close to zero only as their utility collapses, while their COP variants remain stable at the cost of higher EM. O 3 attains the highest utility but fails to forget effectively, with EM above 0.9 at every request. ALKN’s utility falls sharply as requests accumulate.
blocks.zh: 表2:图FU对Llama-3.2-3B-Instructionct(忘却05)的结果,与表1相同的指标和标记。 从第二次请求大会起,从第三次请求本国专业干事起,缔约方会议在每次请求SimNPO和IDK时都提高效用。 基础GA和IDK驱动器仅在其功能崩溃时忘记了接近0的ROUGE,而其COP变体则以较高的EM为代价保持稳定. O 3的功用最高,但未能有效忘却,每次要求的EM高于0.9。 ALKN的功用随着请求的累积而急剧下降.

blocks.en: Across both model sizes, Tables 1 and 2 show that COP consistently slows the utility loss that accumulates over sequential requests, while keeping forgetting close to that of the base objectives, and from the third request onwards, every COP-augmented method retains higher utility than its base objective. The gap is largest for GA and IDK, whose base versions collapse, while their COP variants remain comparable to other methods. Their low forget ROUGE follows this collapse, and thus reflects a degraded model rather than effective unlearning. For NPO and SimNPO, whose base versions degrade more gradually, COP still improves final utility. Forgetting remains comparable for SimNPO and improves for NPO on the 1B model, while on the 3B model NPO+COP shows higher FR in exchange for its larger utility gain.
blocks.zh: 在两个模型规模中,表1和表2显示,缔约方会议一贯减缓因顺序请求而累积的功用损失,同时不断忘记与基准目标相近的功用损失,从第三次请求开始,缔约方会议强化的每个方法的功用都高于其基准目标。 GA和IDK差距最大,其基础版本崩溃,而它们的COP变体仍然与其他方法相当. 他们低沉的忘却了ROUGE跟随这种崩溃,从而反映出一种退化的模式而不是有效的不学习. 对NPO和SimNPO而言,其基本版本逐步退化,缔约方会议仍然改进了最终用途。 对SimNPO来说,遗忘仍然是可比的,在1B模型上,NPO有了改进,而在3B模型上,NPO+COP显示出较高的FR,以换取更大的效用收益。

blocks.en: Figure 2 traces this utility gap over the stream for the 1B model. With no earlier deletions to protect at the first request, COP leaves that update unconstrained, and each base objective and its COP variant reach similar utility after it. Trajectories diverge from the second request onwards, as base objectives lose utility with each request while their COP variants decline slowly. This matches the behavior COP is designed for, which is not to reduce the cost of an individual deletion, but to prevent that cost from compounding as requests accumulate.
blocks.zh: 图2为1B模型在溪流中追踪到这个公用漏洞. 由于在第一次请求时没有提前删除要保护的内容,缔约方会议留下了更新不受限制的内容,每个基准目标及其缔约方会议变体在更新之后也达到类似的用途。 轨迹与第二次请求不同,因为基准目标与每项请求失去效用,而缔约方会议变式则缓慢下降。 这与行为COP的设计相匹配,它不是为了降低个人删除的成本,而是为了防止该成本随着请求的积累而复合.

blocks.en: Finally, among continual baselines, O 3 maintains nearly constant utility, but at the cost of not forgetting effectively when compared to the other methods. Both effects likely stem from its out-of-distribution detector, which scales the unlearning adapter by how similar each query is to the forget data. Queries judged dissimilar are answered by the unmodified base model, which preserves utility on retain data, but any forget query that the detector fails to flag is also answered by the base model, and thus remains unforgotten. ALKN shows the opposite behavior, as its utility collapses within the first few requests on both models, so its near-zero forget ROUGE, as for base GA and IDK, reflects a degraded model rather than effective unlearning. Appendix D further shows that, within the ranks we test, increasing the rank cap r max r_{\max} improves utility without preventing later deletions, since extraction strength stays nearly constant.
blocks.zh: 最后,在连续基线中,O 3保持了几乎不变的效用,但与其他方法相比,代价是不会有效地忘记。 这两种效果都可能源于其分流外探测器,该探测器通过每个查询与遗忘的数据的相似程度来衡量未学习适配器的大小. 被判断不相似的查询由未修改的基模型解答,该基模型保留了保留数据的效用,但任何关于检测器未能标注的忘却查询也由基模型解答,因此仍不被遗忘. ALKN显示的是相反的行为,因为它的效用在两种模型的前几个请求中崩溃,所以它几乎零忘ROUGE,就基础GA和IDK而言,反映了一个退化的模型,而不是有效的不学习. 附 录 D进一步显示,在我们测试的军衔范围内,提高军衔上限(r max r_{\max)可以提高效用,而不会阻止以后的删除,因为提取强度几乎保持不变.

Utility under COP remains stable as requests accumulate, while base objectives fluctuate or degrade.

blocks.en: Table 3: RWKU results on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct . After each task, forget metrics are computed over all requests seen so far, and model utility (MU) is measured on the retained subjects and world facts. Bold marks the higher MU within each pair of a base objective and its COP-augmented variant. COP keeps utility stable across requests, while O 3 forgets at the cost of most of its utility and ALKN retains much of the targeted knowledge.
blocks.zh: 表3:RWKU对Llama-3.2-3B-指示的结果 在每项任务之后,对迄今所看到的所有请求都计算出忘却指标,并根据保留的主题和世界事实衡量模型效用。 粗体标出每对基准目标内较高的MU及其COP强化变体。 COP使各种要求的效用保持稳定,而O 3则以大部分效用为代价而忘记,ALKN保留了大部分目标知识。

blocks.en: 4.2 RWKU
blocks.zh: 4.2 卢旺达

blocks.en: RWKU ( Jin et al., 2024 ) targets knowledge of 200 real, widely known people that a model acquires during pretraining. We use its question-answering probes (level 2), short questions about a person paired with an answer of a few words. We draw 20 people at random with a fixed seed and group them into T = 5 T=5 requests of four people each, so that ℱ k \mathcal{F}_{k} contains all probes of its four people and ℛ \mathcal{R} contains the probes of the 180 people who are never forgotten. We use Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) without further fine-tuning, since the targeted knowledge is already present in the pretrained model. MU is the harmonic mean of answer probability and ROUGE on ℛ \mathcal{R} and of normalized answer probability and ROUGE on the TOFU world-facts questions ( Maini et al., 2024 ) . Further details are in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: RWKU(Jin等人,2024年)针对200名真正,广为人知的人,一个模型在预训期间获得的知识. 我们用它的问答探针(第2级),关于一个人的简短问题与几个字的答案对齐. 我们随机抽取20人,用固定的种子将其组合为T=5T=5个请求,每个请求4人,这样Fk\mathcal{F}_{k}包含其4人的所有探测器,R\mathcal{R}包含180人从未被遗忘的探测器. 我们使用Llama-3.2-3B-Instructionct(Grattafiori等人,2024年)而不作进一步的微调,因为目标知识已经存在于预训模式中. MU是R\mathcal{R}上的解答概率和ROUGE的谐调平均值,也是TOFU世界事实问题上的解答概率和ROUGE的谐调平均值(Maini等人,2024年)。 详情见附录C.2。

blocks.en: COP remains effective when the targeted knowledge comes from pretraining, stabilizing utility across the stream while base objectives fluctuate or degrade. Table 3 and Figure 3 show the effect is clearest for GA, whose base version collapses at the fourth request while GA+COP declines more smoothly, and SimNPO and IDK with COP keep utility nearly constant while their base versions decline. NPO shows a different trade-off, as NPO+COP forgets considerably more than NPO while reaching the same final utility.
blocks.zh: 如果目标知识来自预训,稳定整个流的效用,而基本目标波动或退化,缔约方会议仍然有效。 表3和图3显示效果对GA来说是最清晰的,GA+COP第四次请求时其基版崩溃,而GA+COP则更顺利的下降,SimNPO和COP的IDK在基版衰减时几乎保持不变. 本国专业干事有不同的取舍,因为本国专业干事+COP在达成相同的最终用途的同时,忘记的远远多于本国专业干事。

blocks.en: The continual baselines behave differently than on TOFU, as O 3 now forgets effectively but loses most of its utility, while ALKN retains much of the targeted knowledge at low utility, so neither matches the trade-off of COP variants. Note that utility under most runs and every COP variant rises slightly above the original model. This is expected, since the retain loss is computed on ℛ \mathcal{R} and MU is partly evaluated on the same distribution.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed Continual Orthogonal Projection, a continual unlearning method that projects each update away from activation subspaces cached from earlier forget sets.
This leaves earlier unlearning objectives unchanged to first order without storing past data and without modifying the underlying unlearning loss.
Across TOFU and RWKU, COP substantially reduced the utility loss that accumulates over sequential requests while keeping forgetting comparable, offering a practical option for deployed models facing an ongoing stream of deletion requests, without adding inference cost.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了连续正弦投影,一种持续不学习的方法,将每次更新从从先前的遗忘集缓存的激活子空间中预测出来.
这使得早期的未学习目标保持不变,无法在不储存过去的数据和不改变潜在的未学习损失的情况下第一顺序。
在TOFU和RWKU两地,缔约方会议大幅度减少了因相继请求而累积的效用损失,同时始终忘记可比,为正在面临一系列删除请求的部署模式提供了一个实际的选择,但不增加推论费用。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: COP leaves earlier forget losses exactly unchanged only on inputs whose activations lie in the cached subspaces, and only if the realized update is projected and every trainable parameter is a linear weight. Our runs relax these conditions, since compression keeps at most r max r_{\max} directions per request, AdamW and weight decay act after the projection, and embeddings and normalization gains are not projected, so the protection we observe is approximate. The protected subspace also grows with every request, which limits the length of the stream a fixed rank can support. Our evaluation uses a single seed, five requests, models of up to 3B parameters, and forget metrics on the training probes, and does not include relearning or extraction attacks. COP should therefore not be treated as a certified deletion mechanism or as sufficient on its own for legal or regulatory compliance. Finally, unlearning methods are dual-use, since the same procedure could remove safety-relevant knowledge or suppress legitimate information.
blocks.zh: COP离开之前,仅仅在激活位于缓存子空间的输入上完全忘记损失,并且只有当实现的更新被预测,每个可训练参数都是线性重量时才会忘记损失。 我们的运行放松了这些条件, 因为压缩最多保持 r max 方向每个请求, 亚当W和重量衰减 行为在投影后, 而嵌入和正常化收益 没有预测, 所以我们观察到的保护是近似的。 受保护的子空间也随着每个请求而增长,这限制了固定等级可以支持的流的长度. 我们的评价使用一个单一的种子,五个请求,最多3B参数的模型,在训练探测器上忘记了测量,不包括重新学习或提取攻击. 因此,不应将缔约方会议视为经认证的删除机制,或仅作为遵守法律或规章的充分机制。 最后,不学习方法具有双重用途,因为同一程序可以消除与安全有关的知识或压制合法信息。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en:
Exact unlearning retrains the model without the forget data ( Cao and Yang, 2015 ; Bourtoule et al., 2021 ) . Certified variants bound how far the unlearned model can be from a retrained one ( Guo et al., 2020 ) .
Both become impractical at LLM scale, so most work fine-tunes the deployed model directly.
Gradient ascent ( Jang et al., 2023 ) is the simplest approach, as it maximizes the next-token loss on the forget set, but its loss is unbounded and quickly erodes general utility.
NPO ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) adapts DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) to the case where only rejected responses are available, penalizing the likelihood ratio between the current and the reference model on forget answers. SimNPO ( Fan et al., 2025 ) removes the need for a reference model and uses the length-normalized log-likelihood of the forget answer instead, and IDK ( Maini et al., 2024 ) instead trains the model to answer forget queries with a refusal such as “I don’t know”. Its preference-based variant applies DPO with the refusal as the preferred response and the original answer as the rejected one.
blocks.zh:
准确的不学习重现模型,没有忘却数据(曹和杨,2015;Bourtoule等人,2021). 认证的变体决定了未学习模型与再训练模型的距离(Guo等人,2020年)。
两者在LLM规模上都变得不切实际,所以大多数工作都直接对部署的模型进行微调.
渐渐上升(英語:Jang et al., 2023)是最简单的方法,因为它使遗忘集的下一触失最大化,但其损失是无限制的,并很快侵蚀了一般的效用.
NPO(Zhang等人,2024年)将DPO(Rafailov等人,2023年)适应只有被拒绝答复的案件,惩罚了当前与遗忘答案参考模型之间的概率比. SimNPO(Fan et al.,2025年)取消了参考模型的需要,而是使用了遗忘答案的长度常态化的对日志相似性,IDK(Maini et al.,2024年)则训练模型以拒绝回答遗忘的询问,如"我不知道". 其基于优惠的变式适用DPO,拒绝作为首选答复,原答案作为被拒绝的答复.

blocks.en: Other methods map the target knowledge to a generic replacement ( Eldan and Russinovich, 2023 ) , perturb internal representations of it ( Li et al., 2024 ) , or subtract a task vector learned on the forget data ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 其他方法将目标知识映射到一个通用的替代物(Eldan and Russinovich, 2023年),扰动其内部表现(Li等人, 2024年),或减去从忘却数据(Ilharco等人, 2023年)中汲取的任务矢量.

blocks.en: When deletion requests arrive one after another, each update can damage general utility and also undo earlier deletions, and these effects compound over the sequence. O 3 ( Gao et al., 2025 ) trains a shared LoRA adapter under an orthogonality regularizer and uses an out-of-distribution detector to decide at inference time how strongly the adapter is applied. ALKN ( Wuerkaixi et al., 2025 ) works on the weights directly, combining task-vector negation with gradient masks that discourage requests from reusing the same parameters. FIT ( Xu et al., 2026 ) filters redundant requests and, for each remaining one, selects an unlearning algorithm according to its estimated importance and restricts the update to attributed layers. CURaTE ( Bae et al., 2026 ) leaves the weights untouched and refuses queries that a sentence embedder judges similar to stored forget requests, so the targeted information remains in the parameters.
blocks.zh: 当删除请求相继到达时,每次更新都会损害一般的效用,同时也会取消先前的删除,这些效果复合于序列. O 3(Gao等人,2025年)在正交调节器下培训一个共享的LORA适配器,并使用离散探测器在推断时决定适配器应用的强度. ALKN(Wuerkaixi等人,2025年)直接研究权重,将任务执行者否定与梯度面具结合起来,阻止请求重用相同的参数。 FIT(徐等人,2026年)过滤冗余请求,并根据估计的重要性选择一个未学习算法,并将更新限制在归属层. CURaTE(Bae et al., 2026)将权重留置不动,并拒绝询问一个判决嵌入了类似存储的忘却请求的裁判,因此目标信息仍然留在参数中.

blocks.en: Continual learning faces the same interference between sequential updates, with earlier tasks to retain instead of earlier deletions to preserve. OGD ( Farajtabar et al., 2020 ) projects each new gradient orthogonally to gradients stored from earlier tasks. GPM ( Saha et al., 2021 ) stores, for each layer, a low-rank basis of the input activations of earlier tasks and projects updates orthogonally to it, which leaves that layer’s outputs on those inputs unchanged. COP builds on the activation-space projection of GPM and applies it to the subspaces of past forget sets, so that the quantity it protects is the value each earlier unlearning objective reached.
blocks.zh: 连续学习在顺序更新之间面临同样的干扰,更早的任务要保留而不是更早的删除来保存. OGD(Farajtabar等人,2020年)将每个新的梯度正向到从以前的任务中存储的梯度进行预测。 GPM(Saha等人, 2021年)为每一层存储了早期任务和项目输入激活的低级基础, COP基于GPM的激活-空间投影,并将其应用于过去遗忘集的子空间,这样它所保护的数量就是较早实现的每个未学习目标的价值.

blocks.en:
Several unlearning methods project the forget update to protect retained data within a single request. PGU ( Hoang et al., 2024 ) computes a GPM-style basis of each layer’s input activations on the retained data and projects the forget gradient onto its orthogonal complement, and UNSC ( Chen et al., 2024 ) confines unlearning to the null space of the remaining classes’ layer inputs; both target image classifiers.
In LLMs, GU ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) projects the update of an arbitrary gradient-based unlearning objective orthogonally to the span of retain gradients, which keeps the retain loss unchanged to first order. These methods protect the retain set but not earlier deletions.
Two methods apply projection across sequential requests. FG-OrIU ( Feng et al., 2025 ) decomposes layer features into forgetting and remaining subspaces, projects gradients with respect to both, and adds a loss that makes forget features orthogonal to them, expanding the forgetting subspace as requests arrive; it is evaluated on vision models and couples the projection with its own objective. Lee et al. (2026) study continual unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models and propose a gradient projection that keeps parameter drift orthogonal to the subspace of concepts semantically related to each target. COP differs from these in targeting LLMs, in protecting the earlier forget sets themselves through cached activation subspaces, and in leaving the unlearning objective unchanged.
blocks.zh:
几种不学习的方法预测忘却更新,以保护单个请求中保留的数据。 PGU(Hoang 等人, 2024年)计算每一层在保留数据上输入激活的GPM风格基础,并将遗忘梯度投射到其正向补充上,而UNC(Chen 等人, 2024年)则将不学习限制在剩余类层输入的空格;两个目标图像分类器。
在LLMs中,GU(周等人,2025年)预测将任意的基于梯度的不学习目标正统更新到保留梯度的跨度,使保留损失保持不变到第一顺序. 这些方法保护保留集,但不早于删除.
两种方法适用于顺序请求的预测。 FG-ORIU(Feng等人,2025年)将地层特征分解为遗忘和剩余子空间,对两者进行梯度项目,并增加一种损失,使遗忘的特征具有正向性,随着请求的到来而扩大遗忘子空间;它根据视觉模型和对等的投影进行评价,并有其自身的目标. 李等编. (2026年)研究在文本到图像传播模型中持续不学习,并提出梯度投影,使参数漂移正向与每个目标紧密相关的概念的子空间保持参数漂移. COP在以LLMs为目标、保护早先的遗忘者通过缓存激活子空间自我设定以及使未学习目标保持不变方面与这些不同。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价尺度

blocks.en: Both benchmarks consist of short questions with ground-truth answers, so we evaluate them with a common set of metrics. Forget ROUGE (FR) is the ROUGE-L recall of the ground-truth answer against the model’s greedy generation. Forget probability (FP) is the length-normalized probability of the ground-truth answer. Exact memorization (EM) ( Tirumala et al., 2022 ) is the fraction of answer tokens that match the model’s top prediction given the preceding ground-truth tokens. Extraction strength (ES) ( Carlini et al., 2021 ) is one minus the fraction of the answer that must be given as a prefix before the model’s greedy predictions reproduce the remainder exactly. After request k k , forget metrics are averaged over the pooled examples of ℱ 1 , … , ℱ k \mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{F}_{k} . Model utility (MU) is a harmonic mean of answer probability and ROUGE on data the model should retain, with a composition specific to each benchmark and given in its setup, so utilities are not comparable across benchmarks. Forget quality ( Maini et al., 2024 ) requires a model trained without the forget data, which is available only for TOFU, and we use it solely for hyperparameter selection (Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.en: C.1 TOFU
blocks.zh: C.1 托芬语

blocks.en: TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) consists of 4,000 synthetic question-answer pairs, 20 for each of 200 fictitious authors whose biographies were generated by GPT-4, so none of this knowledge can appear in pretraining data. Because the authors are fictitious, the benchmark also provides a reference model fine-tuned only on the retain set, which approximates the ideal outcome of unlearning; we use the retain95 reference models released by Dorna et al. (2025) . Questions about real authors and world facts, used in MU, probe whether general knowledge survives unlearning.
blocks.zh: TOFU(Maini等人,2024年)由4000个合成的问答对组成,其中200个假作者的传记是由GPT-4生成的,每人20个,因此这些知识都无法出现在预训练数据中. 由于作者是虚构的,该基准还提供了一个仅对保留集进行微调的参考模型,这大致相当于不学习的理想结果;我们使用Dorna等人(2025年)发布的保留95参考模型. 在MU中使用的关于真实作者和世界事实的问题,探究一般知识是否存续不学.

blocks.en:
COP additionally searches τ ∈ { 0.90 , 0.95 , 0.99 } \tau\in\{0.90,0.95,0.99\} . For each method and variant, we select the configuration with the highest Continual Retain-Forget Score (CRFS), the harmonic mean between model utility and forget quality, both measured after the final request.
Forget quality (FQ) ( Maini et al., 2024 ) is the p p -value of a two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test between the truth ratio distributions of the unlearned model and the retain-only reference model on the forget set. The truth ratio compares the likelihood the model assigns to paraphrased correct answers against perturbed incorrect ones, so a high FQ means the two distributions are statistically indistinguishable, while a low FQ indicates that the unlearned model still behaves differently from a model that never saw the forgotten authors. We compute FQ over the union of all forget requests, so it penalizes configurations that let earlier deletions resurface. The harmonic mean is dominated by the lower of its two terms, so CRFS discards configurations that either collapse utility or barely forget, which a single metric would favor. Since FQ is a p p -value, it serves well as a selection criterion but is not directly comparable as a measure of forgetting strength, so we report memorization metrics in the main text instead.

blocks.en: We load the forget_level2 configuration of RWKU, whose single split contains 2,879 question-answer probes, each annotated with the person it concerns. The 20 forget people are sampled from the distinct people sorted by name, independently of the training seed, so they are the same for every method and run, and consecutive groups of four form ℱ 1 , … , ℱ 5 \mathcal{F}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{F}_{5} . We use every probe of a selected person, without filtering probes by whether the base model answers them correctly before unlearning.

blocks.en: Each probe is posed with the RWKU question prompt as a single user turn, and the assistant turn begins with a prefilled Answer: that the model completes with the answer. The prefix is excluded from every loss and metric. Generation is greedy and stops at the first newline or after 32 new tokens, and ROUGE is computed with stemming. Cumulative forget metrics average per probe over the pooled requests.
blocks.zh: 每个探测器都与RWKU问题即时作为单一用户转弯提出,助手转弯开始一个预先填充的回答:即模型用答案完成. 每个损失和度量中都不包括前缀。 世代贪婪,在第一新线或32个新代号之后停止,ROUGE是用终止来计算. 每个探测器对集合请求的累积忘却平均值。

blocks.en: IDK replaces each forget answer with a refusal drawn from a fixed list, assigned deterministically by example index so that a probe receives the same refusal whenever it is seen, and prefixed with Answer: . O 3 trains LoRA adapters of rank 8, scaling factor 32, and dropout 0.05 0.05 on the attention and MLP projections, with a per-device batch of 1, 4 accumulation steps, and weight decay 0.1 0.1 . It trains on the same refusal targets, uses no retain data, and configures its out-of-distribution detector with the TOFU settings, scored on the raw question text.
blocks.zh: IDK 将每个忘答替换为从固定列表中抽取的拒绝,按实例索引进行确定性分配,以便一个探测器在看到时得到同样的拒绝,并前缀为Answer: . O 3次列车的LORA适配器等级为8级,缩放系数32,注意度和MLP预测值为0.05 0.05,每组装置为1,4堆积步骤,重量衰减0.1 0.1. 它在同一拒绝目标上进行训练,不使用保留数据,并以TOFU设置配置其外分配探测器,在原始问题文本上得分.

blocks.en: COP fixes τ = 0.99 \tau=0.99 , giving three COP runs per baseline configuration. In total the grid has 30 baseline runs, 90 COP runs, 9 O 3 runs, 12 ALKN runs, and one evaluation of the unmodified base model at every request. Forget quality requires a reference model trained without the forget data, which RWKU cannot provide because its knowledge comes from pretraining. For each method and variant, we therefore select the configuration with the highest harmonic mean of model utility and one minus exact memorization, measured after the final request, with exact memorization computed over the union of all requests.
blocks.zh: COP修正 = 0.99\tau= 0.99, 使COP 运行每个基线配置。 电网总共有30个基准运行,90个COP运行,9个O 3运行,12个ALKN运行,以及应请求对未修改的基准模型进行一次评估. 忘却质量要求一个在没有忘却数据的情况下训练的参考模型,RWKU无法提供,因为其知识来自预训. 因此,对于每一种方法和变体,我们都会选择具有最高的调谐值的模型功用配置,并在最后请求后进行精确的计算,精确地计算出所有请求的结合。

blocks.zh: 附录D 亚空间等级上限的效果

blocks.en: The rank cap r max r_{\max} bounds how many directions each request adds to the protected subspace. A larger cap protects earlier deletions and retained behavior more completely, but it also restricts the directions available to later requests, which could make new deletions harder to achieve. We study this trade-off by varying r max r_{\max} on TOFU with Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, keeping the stream of five requests and the remaining setup of Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 等级上限 r max r max } 限定每个请求为受保护的子空间增加多少方向 。 更大的上限可以保护更早的删除和保留行为更彻底,但也限制了以后的请求可用的方向,这可能会使新的删除更难实现. 我们在TOFU和Llama-3.2-1B-指令上通过不同方式研究这种取舍,保持5项请求的流畅和其余第4.1节的设置。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Larger protected subspaces improve utility without weakening forgetting. Final model utility (left) and extraction strength (right) on TOFU with Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, as a function of the COP rank cap r max r_{\max} . “Base” denotes each objective without COP, and dotted lines mark the original model. Utility grows with rank for all methods, sharply for GA and IDK and moderately for NPO and SimNPO, while extraction strength remains far below original model at every rank.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 更大的受保护的子空间改善效用而不削弱遗忘. 最终型号功用(左)和提取强度(右)与Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct,作为COP军衔上限r max r_{\max 的功能. “基准”是指没有缔约方会议参与的每个目标,虚线标注原型。 各种方法的效用随级别而增加,GA和IDK的功率急剧提高,NPO和SimNPO的功率也略有提高,而在每个级别上,抽取的实力仍然远远低于原始模式。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that final utility grows with r max r_{\max} for every objective, sharply for GA and IDK and moderately for NPO and SimNPO, as protecting more directions further limits interference with earlier deletions and retained knowledge. Extraction strength, in contrast, stays nearly constant across ranks and far below that of the original model, so the restriction on later updates does not prevent new deletions from taking effect. Within the range we test, increasing the rank cap thus improves utility at no cost to forgetting, and its main cost is the memory needed to store the protected basis.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,每个目标的最后用途都随着最大功率增长,GA和IDK的功率急剧上升,NPO和SimNPO的功率略有上升,因为保护更多的方向进一步限制了对先前删除和保留知识的干扰。 相比之下,采掘强度在各级别之间几乎保持不变,远远低于原型号,因此对后来更新的限制并不妨碍新的删除生效. 在我们测试的范围之内,提高军衔上限从而在不费任何费用的情况下提高效用,其主要成本是存储受保护基础所需的内存.
